title: Rice husk derived graphene-like material: Activation with phosphoric acid in the absence of inert gas for hydrogen gas storage
material_description: GRHA 1:1 | rice husk derived graphene-like carbon, H3PO4 activated (1 M H3PO4), activated without inert gas
purification_method: After activation: washed with warm distilled water, sonicated about 30 min, centrifuged at 4000 rpm to neutral pH, vacuum filtered, dried 24 h at 80 C
activation_method: H3PO4 impregnation of rice husk ash (carbonized at 350 C, 2 h) at 80 C for 2 h, dried 24 h at 100 C, calcined at 700 C for 2 h in a crucible packed with ceramic wool and carbon powder (no inert gas)
functional_groups: C=C of aromatic rings (about 1627 cm-1), C=O, =C-H (1000-1200 cm-1); -OH absent after activation (FTIR)
source_location: Text p.31091 (wt%), Table 4 (mmol/g, qe,exp), Fig. 10 (kinetic curve); porosity Table 1
notes: Printed units disagree: mmol/g value x 0.201588 = 68.9 wt% vs printed 0.68 wt% (unit-consistency failure); both stored as printed. H2 uptake at 30 bar is the equilibrium end value of the uptake-time curve (Fig. 10, kinetics, not digitized). Basis not named; volumetric rig, so instrumental default excess. Pressure printed as 30 bar, gauge/absolute not stated. Printed uncertainty +/-0.0100% (relative, Table 4) not in wt%, uncertainty_wt_pct left empty. Pre-adsorption drying overnight at 120 C in oven (duration not stated), then N2 purge and vacuum; recorded as degassing. Rig is custom-made static volumetric (Fig. 2 schematic); no free-volume calibration stated. BET: N2 at 77 K, Quantachrome TouchWin, degassed 150 C overnight; BET range not stated. Pore size distribution by DFT (Fig. 5, Table 1). Total pore volume printed 0.22/0.21/0.17 in Table 1 (abstract gives 0.2069 for GRHA 1:3). Temperature stated only as 'room temperature' (text, abstract); Table 3 gives 25 C only for the 1.95 wt% GRHA value, so left empty and flagged unstated. mmol/g printed 341.59 in text and Table 4. Sample label: Table 3 prints 'GRHA' generically; sample label taken from text and Table 4. Sample numbering follows the Method order (RHA has no H2 value).
